commit_message:
FROMGIT: KVM: arm64: Check the untrusted offset in FF-A memory share

Verify the offset to prevent OOB access in the hypervisor
FF-A buffer in case an untrusted large enough value
[U32_MAX - sizeof(struct ffa_composite_mem_region) + 1, U32_MAX]
is set from the host kernel.

Bug: 439862698
(cherry picked from commit 103e17aac09cdd358133f9e00998b75d6c1f1518
https://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/kvmarm/kvmarm.git fixes)
